title: French Cannellini Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired stew made with cannellini beans, aromatic vegetables, and a hint of Syrian spices.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Syrian spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cannellini beans, stew, and chopped aromatic. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme.
